title: Analyzing Norm Violations in Live-Stream Chat

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by calculating changes in inter-annotator agreement (via exact match, partial match, and majority vote percentages) across three stages of data annotation with varying levels of provided context (single utterance, multi-user chat context, and video context) to demonstrate how context mitigates subjective annotator bias.

Evaluated by defining a 'Discrimination' norm violation category for live-stream chats and testing the performance (Precision, Recall, F1 score) of existing toxicity detection frameworks (ToxiGen, Perspective API, OpenAI moderation/content filters) as well as fine-tuned context-aware models in detecting user-generated discriminatory comments.
